scientific_integrity: The selected primary combinatorial source is dated 31 July 2004 by its publisher; earlier dated-by-year literature on the Pasch switch is cited as structural context. No claim of independent certification is made. All finite certificates are included and reproducible.
scientific_limitations: Complete homotopy types are proved only for the two Steiner triple systems of order thirteen; no general formula for higher orders or full automorphism character of the noncyclic design is asserted. No independent external audit has been performed. Unindexed equivalent earlier coverage remains possible.
title: The two thirteen-point Steiner cap complexes are wedges of twelve and seventeen four-spheres
